title: Device Fingerprinting Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your device fingerprinting risk score. Assess how easily websites can track you through browser and device characteristics.
description: Evaluate your vulnerability to device fingerprinting attacks. This calculator analyzes your browser settings, device characteristics, and privacy measures to determine how uniquely identifiable you are online.

inputs.label: Your Browser's Fingerprinting Defense

options.label: Hides or randomizes the device details it reports
Makes every user report the same values

inputs.helpText: Check your browser's privacy settings. The strongest defense makes all its users look alike, so no one stands out.

inputs.label: Ad Blocker Installed
inputs.helpText: Ad blockers can reduce fingerprinting scripts

inputs.label: VPN Usage
inputs.helpText: How often you use a VPN while browsing

inputs.label: Screen Resolution Uniqueness
inputs.helpText: Rate how unique your screen resolution is

inputs.label: Fingerprint Protection Enabled
inputs.helpText: An anti-fingerprinting extension or setting you turned on yourself, beyond your browser's defaults

outputFields.label: Fingerprinting Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall likelihood of being uniquely identified

outputFields.label: Device Uniqueness Level
outputFields.description: How distinctive your device fingerprint is

formula: let baseRisk = 70; const defenseBonus = { 'none': 0, 'blocks-scripts': -10, 'masks': -25, 'uniform': -40 }; baseRisk += defenseBonus[fingerprintDefense] ?? 0; if (!jsEnabled) baseRisk -= 25; if (adBlocker) baseRisk -= 15; if (fingerprintProtection) baseRisk -= 20; if (vpnUsage === 'always') baseRisk -= 15; else if (vpnUsage === 'sometimes') baseRisk -= 7; baseRisk += screenResolution * 2; baseRisk += Math.min(extensions * 2, 20); baseRisk = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, baseRisk)); let grade = 'A'; if (baseRisk > 20) grade = 'B'; if (baseRisk > 40) grade = 'C'; if (baseRisk > 70) grade = 'D'; let protection = 'Strong'; if (baseRisk > 20) protection = 'Moderate'; if (baseRisk > 40) protection = 'Weak'; if (baseRisk > 70) protection = 'Poor'; return { riskScore: baseRisk, uniqueness: grade, protectionLevel: protection };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates multiple fingerprinting vectors including your browser's fingerprinting defense, enabled features, screen characteristics, and protection measures. It weighs each factor based on research into real-world fingerprinting techniques used by tracking companies.
tips: Use a browser that resists fingerprinting by default, or turn on the strongest anti-fingerprinting setting yours offers
Disable JavaScript on sensitive sites or use NoScript extensions
Install ad blockers and anti-fingerprinting extensions
Use common screen resolutions and avoid unique browser configurations
Enable built-in fingerprint protection features when available

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
